163                                       .withActions(new RunnableAction((click)->{
164
165                                         final File directory = new File(PluginCore.directory(), "currency");

168                                         MISCUtils.deleteFolder(directory);
169
170                                         TNECore.eco().currency().getSaver().saveCurrencies(directory);
171
172                                         try {
173
174                                           TNECore.eco().currency().getCurrencies().clear();
175                                           TNECore.eco().currency().getCurIDMap().clear();
176
177                                           TNECore.eco().currency().getLoader().loadCurrencies(directory);
178
179
180                                           final Optional<MenuViewer> viewer = click.player().viewer();
181                                           if(viewer.isPresent()) {
182                                             viewer.get().addData("CURRENCY_SAVED_CONFIRM", true);
183                                           }
184
185                                           final Optional<PlayerProvider> provider = PluginCore.server().findPlayer(id);
186                                           if(provider.isPresent()) {
187                                             provider.get().message(new MessageData("Messages.Menu.MyEco.Main.Saved"));
188                                           }
189
190                                         } catch(final NoValidCurrenciesException ignore) { }

218        addCurrencyIcon.addAction(new ChatAction((message)->{

220          if(message.getPlayer().viewer().isPresent()) {

222            if(TNECore.eco().currency().find(message.getMessage()).isPresent()) {

231          }

235        addCurrencyIcon.addAction(new RunnableAction((run)->run.player().message("Enter an identifier for the currency:")));
236        currency.addIcon(addCurrencyIcon);

409          if(currencyOpt.isPresent()) {
410
411            Currency currencyObject = (Currency)currencyOpt.get();
412
413            final CurrencyType origType = TNECore.eco().currency().findTypeOrDefault(currencyObject.getType());
414            final CurrencyType newType = TNECore.eco().currency().findTypeOrDefault(type.name());
415            if(origType.supportsItems() && !newType.supportsItems() || !origType.supportsItems() && newType.supportsItems()) {
416              currencyObject.setType(type.name());
417
418              currencyObject = Currency.clone(currencyObject, newType.supportsItems());
419              TNECore.eco().currency().addCurrency(currencyObject);
420              click.player().viewer().get().addData(ACTIVE_CURRENCY, currencyObject);
421
422            } else {
423              currencyObject.setType(type.name());
424            }
425          }
426        }
427      }));
428      switchIcon.addActions();

1167  private void handleDenominationOpen(final PageOpenCallback callback) {
1168
1169    final Optional<MenuViewer> viewer = callback.getPlayer().viewer();
1170    if(viewer.isPresent()) {
1171
1172      final UUID id = viewer.get().uuid();
1173
1174      callback.getPage().addIcon(new PreviousPageIcon(id, 0, this.name, CURRENCY_EDIT_PAGE, ActionType.ANY));
1175
1176      final Optional<Object> currencyOpt = viewer.get().findData(ACTIVE_CURRENCY);
1177      if(currencyOpt.isPresent()) {
1178
1179        //add denomination
1180        final SwitchPageIcon addDenominationIcon = new SwitchPageIcon(2, PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("ARROW", 1)
1181                .customName(MessageHandler.grab(new MessageData("Messages.Menu.MyEco.Currency.AddDenominationDisplay"), id))
1182                .lore(Collections.singletonList(MessageHandler.grab(new MessageData("Messages.Menu.MyEco.Currency.AddDenominationLore"), id))), this.name, DENOMINATIONS_PAGE, ActionType.ANY);
1183        addDenominationIcon.addAction(new ChatAction((message)->{
1184
1185          if(message.getPlayer().viewer().isPresent()) {
1186
1187            try {
1188
1189              final BigDecimal weight = new BigDecimal(message.getMessage());
1190              final Currency currencyObject = (Currency)currencyOpt.get();
1191              if(currencyObject.getDenominations().containsKey(weight)) {
1192                message.getPlayer().message("A denomination with that weight already exists! Enter a valid decimal for the weight of the denomination:");
1193                return false;
1194              }
1195              final Denomination denomObj = (currencyObject instanceof ItemCurrency)? new ItemDenomination(weight) : new Denomination(weight);
1196              currencyObject.getDenominations().put(weight, denomObj);
1197
1198              message.getPlayer().viewer().get().addData(ACTIVE_DENOMINATION, denomObj);
1199              return true;
1200            } catch(final NumberFormatException ignore) { }
1201          }
1202          message.getPlayer().message("Enter a valid decimal for the weight of the denomination:");
1203          return false;
1204        }));
1205        addDenominationIcon.addAction(new RunnableAction((run)->run.player().message("Enter a valid decimal for the weight of the denomination:")));
1206        callback.getPage().addIcon(addDenominationIcon);
1207
1208        final Currency currency = (Currency)currencyOpt.get();
1209        int i = 19;
1210        for(final Denomination denomObj : currency.getDenominations().values()) {
1211
1212          callback.getPage().addIcon(new DenominationIcon(id, i, denomObj));
1213
1214          i += 2;
1215        }
1216      }
1217    }
1218  }
